crossRefs.note: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.
the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, offered. These were the princes of the tribes. These are…
“These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the…
Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds…
Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded.
translations.bsb: Then Moses said to the heads of the tribes of Israel, “This is what the LORD has commanded:
translations.kjv: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded.
translations.asv: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded.
